notes.title: Updated Demo
notes.notes:
What has changed:

• The tutorial has been enhanced. It now provides a clearer explanation of how abilities work.
• More narration has been added to the game. Both the prologue screens and an in-game side dialogue window offer additional lore for players to explore.
• Leveling up gratitude now grants rewards. As you level gratitude levels, you gain opportunities to unlock coven slots and ability slots. Finally, it pays off to pick up that pesky garbage in the forest!
• You can now purchase power-ups for tree spirits using the in-game currency, mulch.
• A Linux version is now available.
• Item handling has been improved. A "collect all" button has been added to troves, and item stats have been adjusted to encourage players to review and compare them for the most desirable bonuses.
• The puzzle selector has undergone a slight revamp.
• FPS and overall stability have been improved.

notes.title: Updates to the demo
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Evokers! We’ve worked up a few improvements for the game demo, like a tale passed around the hearth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45510055/e447cf8bc83aac91ac3dd42877bed250c04653e2.jpg[/img]

One big change is the new skill tree. The old ability discovery trick is back, but it’s different now—more in your hands. We think this way gives you more say in how things go, though we’d like to hear what you reckon. You’ll also notice the game runs smoother, with a solid performance boost and a working vsync. Plus, you can tweak the quality settings a bit to suit your liking.

Step back in, give it a try, and let us know how it feels!

notes.title: Welcome Evokers
notes.notes:
What is this game?

The formula for the game is quite simple. It starts like Cookie Clicker because you click tiles a lot, then it kind of morphs into Vampire Survivors because you manage adding abilities and there are lots of numbers on the screen, to become Diablo, because you focus on getting the best loot and spend a lot of time comparing item stats.

We are still some time away from the release, so please forgive us for not being exactly bug-free. You can expect bugs, but hopefully, you won’t encounter any hard blockers.

If you run into problems or want to finish the demo quickly, press F5 to open the cheat menu and use it at your own risk ;). The '~' key opens the console, but that is probably even more risky to use than the F5 key for now.

We are serious about making this game the best it can be, and we ask you, from the bottom of our hearts, to get engaged and tell us what you would like improved or changed. But we’re getting ahead of ourselves.

As you might have noticed, this game is different. It is different for a reason. We decided to create something novel and to create something with a message. We don’t know what the message is exactly, but we feel it is there. Feel, not know. Maybe you will be able to feel it for yourself?
